posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
Please follow the documentations instructions. This link should take you to the section about importing 3D models.
Modeling
cutievirus.com
Ensure that you have placed the models in the /models folder.
The documentation implies this is only a premium feature, so if you are using a free version of the plugin, then you will need to purchase the full version.
They have a demo project available, I recommend downloading it and seeing how things have been set up so you can imitate what they have done.
MV3D - 3D Rendering Plugin for RPG Maker MV by Cutievirus
Create 3D games with RPG Maker MV
cutievirus.itch.io
(The demo projects are available to be downloaded below the purchase button)
Please be aware, I don't use this plugin, so whatever help I can provide is limited.
